name: scheduled-job
title: Scheduled Job
description: A scheduled background job that runs on a recurring timer — private visibility, a Schedule block, trigger verification, and structured logging.

env.description: The URL to monitor and health-check on each scheduled run. Defaults to https://httpbin.org/status/200 if not set.
env.where_to_find: The address of the service or endpoint you want to health-check.

env.description: Optional bearer token for manual HTTP requests when invoked outside of a scheduled run. A scheduled run skips this check automatically via the trigger header.
env.where_to_find: Any random secret string you generate, e.g. using `openssl rand -hex 24`.

post_deploy:
Your scheduled job is deployed!

This Function is private and runs on a recurring Schedule.

Next steps:
  1. View your active schedules and next run times:
       wawesome cron list
  2. Follow execution logs in real time as scheduled runs fire:
       wawesome logs --follow
  3. Manually trigger a run without waiting for the next timer tick:
       wawesome invoke
  4. Pause or resume the schedule at any time:
       wawesome cron pause health-check
       wawesome cron resume health-check
